utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can ask around about the book club and see who’s in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds good to me. Which book are you all reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I heard they’re picking the next title tonight, so I should be able to stop by and see what they choose.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my ladder if you need anything set up for the book club.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds nice. I’d be curious to hear what book you end up picking.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I’ll bring a few options I’ve been reading lately, and we can pick something good for next month.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll bring my book club notes, and if anyone needs a spare copy, I’ve got one.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s handy, Cleo. I’ll bring my notes too so we can keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That works for me. I’ll bring my notes too, and we’ll have a spare copy if anyone needs one.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think it’s at the new place after school, though I might be mixing up the details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I think it’s the new place after school, but I’d like to double-check before we head over.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think so too, but I’d still double-check the exact spot before we go.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Do we know what time the book club meets? I can help check the details.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think it’s Thursday evening, but I’m not fully sure. If you check, could you let me know?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ll check and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, the book club’s picking up again. What are you reading next?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’d like that. When are you thinking of meeting for book club?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We usually meet on Thursdays, and I can let you know what book we pick if you want.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, good timing - I heard the book club is picking the next title tonight, so I should be able to stop by and hear what they choose.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What night and what time does it meet?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m not sure yet, but I heard they’re deciding tonight. I can stop by and find out the exact details.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds nice. We usually meet on Thursdays, and I can let you know what book we pick if you want.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, that helps. If it’s on Thursday, I can probably stop by your place then.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sure, Thursday works fine. I’ll let you know which book we pick before then.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Tuesday at your place, right? Which book did you pick?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard it got moved, but I’m still waiting on the exact details. Did Noah say where we’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, did Noah actually move the meeting, or are we still on for Tuesday at your place?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right, the book club’s picking their next read tonight. If you’re going, I’d get there a little early.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I should get there early, then. See you tonight.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You too, Bo. Don’t be surprised if the line’s already snaking out the door by the time you get there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, book club is this Thursday at my place - you should come. I’ll text Opal the details too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thursday works for me. I’ll bring the book list and a couple of spare copies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Leo. Bring them along and I’ll have some snacks ready at my place Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Mara, Thursday at the cafe it is, and I’ll keep the sign-up sheet ready for your book choice.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Thursday at the cafe works for me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Mara. I’ll keep the notes and sign-up sheet ready for your book choice.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Nell. Just send me the new place when you have it, and I’ll be there after school.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I still don’t know the new place yet, but I’ll tell you as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No worries, Nell. I’ll plan on after school, and just let me know if the place changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Pia — the book club is now on Thursday at the cafe. I’ve got the sign-up sheet ready if you’d like to pick a book for next month.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds nice. Thursdays work for me, and I’d be glad to see the book choice when you’ve picked it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, then let’s keep it on Thursday at the cafe, and I’ll have the sign-up sheet ready when you’re there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Tuesday at your place, right? Which book did you pick?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Tuesday at my place, and I went with the new mystery the club was debating. I should be there tonight to hear what they pick next.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: The new mystery, right? And you're still set for Tuesday at your place?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, right, the book club. I think I was supposed to bring the list, but I might have left it somewhere again.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries, we can still figure it out from memory.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, that helps. I’m glad we can still pull it together.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds good to me. Which book are you all reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’d love to join. Have you picked a book yet?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Not yet, but I’m happy to read whatever you pick.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll bring my book club notes, and if anyone needs a spare copy, I’ve got one.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, that covers the spares — I’ll bring the book list and copies too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, I’ll bring my notes too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That works for me, especially if I can grab the notes by your place.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What night does the book club meet?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s this Thursday at Quinn’s place, and I can bring the notes by my place if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the book club. I’m still keen to join in, though I may have missed a meeting or two.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, that’s good to hear. I’d be curious what you all are reading lately.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, I’d be curious too, though I may have misplaced the reading list again.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my ladder if the book club needs anything set up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s kind of you, Gus. Thursdays are when we meet, and if you want to bring the ladder, I’m sure we could use the help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, I’ll be there Thursday with the ladder.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I heard it got moved, but I missed where to. Did Mara say the new place?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I think it was moved, but I didn’t catch the new place either. Maybe Mara can fill us in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I still don’t know the new place either. If you hear back, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can ask around and see who’s coming to the book club.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You should come to book club this Thursday at my place, Eli. I’ll text Opal the details too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, I’ll be there Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Do we know what time the book club meets? I can help check the details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m not sure yet, but I can check the time with you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let’s check it together.
